lines.text: Judah settles near Hirah the Adullamite, marries a Canaanite man's daughter, and they have three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah.
Judah gets Tamar as a wife for Er, and the LORD puts Er and then Onan to death for wickedness.
When Judah goes up to Timnah to shear sheep, Tamar covers her face with a veil and sits at the entrance to Bethel.
Judah takes her for a prostitute and promises a young goat, leaving his seal, cord, and staff as a pledge.
Tamar bears twins, and the midwife ties a scarlet thread on the wrist of the one named Hezron, who broke out first.
